reports.report: Regelrechte Artikulation im linken Kniegelenk. Deutliches bone bruise in der lateralen Femurkondyle und im lateralen Tibiaplateau betont posterolateral. Nachweis einer Impressionsfraktur am posterolateralen Tibiaplateau (4/24 oder 1010/47 bzw. 6/22) mit nur minimaler Impression (1010/49). Angrenzend deutliches bone bruise. Anstelle der Fraktur kleiner chondraler Defekt (6/22). Ansonsten regelrechter Knorpelbelag femoropatellar und femorotibial. Vorderes und hinteres Kreuzband intakt. Unauffällige Morphologie und Signalgebung der Menisken. Kollateralbandapparat intakt. Deutlicher Hämarthros. Kleines Osteom interkondylär am Femur (6/18). Aus dem Röntgen bekannte irreguläre Darstellung der Tuberositas tibiae mit ventral gelegenen kleinen Ossikeln innerhalb der Patellasehne. Fabella lateral (3/87). Diffuse Einblutungen/Flüssigkeitseinlagerungen in die Subcutis dorsolateral (3/94).

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Football injury one month ago with decreased range of motion, swelling and pain.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Anterior translation of the tibia relative to the femur. Severe osseous stress response with impaction fracture along the sulcus terminalis of the lateral femoral condyle. Small osseous contusions along the posterolateral and posteromedial tibial plateau. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Moderate, partially ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade cartilage loss at the sulcus terminalis.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Completely ruptured and partially resorbed.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Grade 2 sprain.
Posterolateral corner structures: Mild edema in the posterolateral corner without ligamentous injury.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
Soft tissue edema along the anteromedial joint line likely posttraumatic. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1. Complete rupture of the anterior cruciate ligament with pivot shift osseous contusions including an impaction fracture at the sulcus terminalis with severe osseous stress response.

2. Grade 2 sprain of the medial collateral ligament.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: [DATE]. Patient is unable to bear weight on right leg. Concern for a tibial insufficiency fracture.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Small inner margin fraying and degenerative signal within the posterior horn without extrusion or displaced fragment.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Degenerative signal within the posterior horn without tearing or extrusion.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Moderate distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with multiple foci of low-grade tearing. Associated enthesophyte formation at the patellar attachment with reactive edema extending to the superior patella and peritendinous edema extending into the quadriceps continuation.
Patella tendon: Mild patellar tendinosis. No tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1.	No insufficiency fracture as clinically questioned.
2.	Small inner margin fraying of the medial meniscus without extrusion.
3.	Moderate extensor mechanism tendinopathy with multiple foci of low-grade tearing of the distal quadriceps insertion with enthesophyte formation and reactive marrow edema within the patella.

МР находка: Костите, формиращи дясната колянна става, са с нормална форма и запазена структура. Наличие на локални високосигнални промени в медиалния кондил на фемура. МР данни за ставен излив, разположен основно супрапателарно и дорзално в ставата. Ставният хрущял на тибията, фемура и пателата е съхранен. МР данни за пълна увреда на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Вижда се широка хиперинтензна ивица с кос ход по протежение на целия заден рог, която достига горната и долната ставни повърхности, както и свободната повърхност на менискуса. По съседство на увредения менискус медиално се намират дребнокистични промени без видима връзка с него. Наличие на мекотъканен и костномозъчен едем в тибията по съседство както при контузионен оток в тях. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус. Кръстни връзки – без патологични изменения. Колатералните лигаменти със запазена цялост. Ретинакулуми – б.о.  Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м.квадрицепс феморис – без особености. Не се намират патологични промени в поплитеалната ямка. Заключение: МР данни за пълна увреда на задния рог на медиалния менискус – 3та степен с контузионен едем по съседство. Наличие на ставен излив.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Small joint effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
Normal.

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Normal meniscus. Minimal surface fraying of articular cartilage. Normal lateral collateral ligament structures.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
Normal.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Small linear fracture adjacent to the medial patellar facet, secondary to an avulsion. Full-thickness/complete tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament at the patellar insertion with 1 cm retraction. Intact medial patellar retinaculum.

Patellofemoral profile:
Patella alta (Insall Salvati ratio 1.7).
Evidence of trochlear dysplasia, with trochlear facet asymmetry and a small medial facet (35%).
Normal trochlear sulcus angle (140 degrees).
Borderline TT-TG: 1.6 cm.

Bones:
Bone marrow edema within the medial aspect of the patella and lateral femoral condyle, secondary to recent lateral patellar dislocation. Impaction fracture at the lateral femoral condyle.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
None

CONCLUSION:
1.Sequelae of recent lateral patellar dislocation, with bone marrow edema within the medial patella and lateral femoral condyle which also demonstrates impaction fracture, a small avulsion fracture of the medial aspect of the patella, and a full-thickness/complete tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament at the patellar insertion.
2.Patella alta, with evidence of trochlear dysplasia
3.No meniscal, cruciate, medial or lateral ligament injury.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs anterior horn düzeyinde evre 2 intra meniskal dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri izlendi.Medial menisküs gövde kesiminde bütünlük kaybı izlenmiş olup medial menisküs laterale ekstrüdedir.Medial menisküs gövde-posterior horn düzeyinde kompleks yırtık ile uyumlu görünüm dikkati çekmektedir. Ayrıca medial menisküs posterior kesimde yırtık düzeyinde bütünlük kaybı yırtık lehinedir. Ön çapraz bağda mukoid dejenerasyon ile uyumlu kalınlaşma ve sinyal artımı izlenmiştir. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Retropatellar ve femoral kartilajda kondromalazi ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri izlendi.Diz eklem aralığı ve suprapatellar bursada efüzyon mevcuttur.Diz eklem aralığı medial kompratmanda daha belirgin olmak üzere daralmış görünümde olup medial kompartmanda diz eklemi oluşturan kemik yapılarda kontüzyonel ödem dikkati çekti.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda yaygın dejeneratif sinyal değişiklikleri mevcuttur.Popliteal fossada yaklaşık 3 cm boyutunda baker kisti dikkati çekmiştir.
